dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave spline curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning from a shallow posterior base to a rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius; lacks a sharp or acute vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced hemispherical convexity defining the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak morphology with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees at the transition from the melon arc to the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep V-shaped notch located on the dorsal ridge posterior to the dorsal fin; atypical angular truncation of the caudal fluke trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan surface rendering with visible low-polygon geometric mesh structures.
